callees.name: batch_extract_all
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a path to an existing directory
callees.post_condition: Returns (funcs, langs) where funcs maps each absolute file path to a list of (func_name, body_text) tuples for all functions extracted across all registered language handlers, and langs is the set of language keys that returned non-empty results. Returns ({}, set()) when no language backend is available.

callees.name: _is_test_file
callees.pre_condition: src_rel is a relative file path string
callees.post_condition: Returns True when src_rel denotes a test file according to path-based heuristics (e.g., path component contains 'test' or filename contains test markers); returns False otherwise.

callees.name: extract_functions_from_file
callees.signature: extract_functions_from_file(src_path: str, lang_key: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]
callees.pre_condition: src_path is an absolute path to an existing source file; lang_key is a recognized language identifier
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (func_name, body_text) tuples for all functions found in the file via regex-based extraction for the given language. Returns an empty list if no functions are found or the file cannot be parsed.

callees.name: _safe_filename
callees.pre_condition: func_name is a function name string potentially containing path-unsafe characters; ext is a file extension string
callees.post_condition: Returns a filesystem-safe filename that preserves class-qualifier separators (::), maps '/' to '_', and appends ext as the extension. Returns '_function.<ext>' when func_name is empty.

callees.name: is_file_ready
callees.pre_condition: out_file is a path to an extracted function file that exists on disk
callees.post_condition: Returns True if and only if the file at out_file has both a valid .spec.json sidecar and a valid .info.json sidecar adjacent to it; returns False otherwise.

callees.name: _validate_extraction
callees.signature: _validate_extraction(output_base: str, registry_langs: set[str] | None = None) -> list[tuple[str, int]]
callees.pre_condition: output_base is a path to a directory containing extracted function files
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (file_path, function_count) tuples for every extracted file under output_base that does not contain exactly one function. Returns an empty list when every extracted file contains exactly one function.
